verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of TLS certificate issuance, automatic renewal, custom-domain certificates, or wildcard support on Fly.io. The only related item says Sprites get an HTTPS URL, which is a platform-provided endpoint and not certificate management for every domain, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards
